categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/netaddress.h only for an address comparison helper; the change strictly concerns HTTP server initialization and RPC endpoint binding rather than peer-to-peer networking.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server binding logic and authentication handling in src/httpserver.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a local credential leak where bitcoind could start on IPv6 while an untrusted local process occupies the default IPv4 RPC port, causing bitcoin-cli to send the authentication cookie to the foreign process in plaintext. As verified by reviewers, leaving this unresolved allows local credential capture and unauthorized RPC execution.
